scope: Data required for the evaluation of a food enzyme (Part A): identity of the declared activity, source (microbial, plant, animal), production, characteristics (properties, chemical parameters, purity, viable cells and DNA of the production strain), toxicology and dietary exposure. Applicability follows the source of the enzyme and, for microbial enzymes, whether the production strain is genetically modified and/or qualifies for QPS. Part B (modifications of an authorisation) is not covered.

requirements.requirement: Where the QPS approach is claimed: unequivocal taxonomic status, species on the QPS list, qualifications met; for GMMs, a parental strain qualifying for QPS and a genetic modification giving no concern. requirements.title: Risk characterisation (margin of exposure)
requirements.requirement: Margin of exposure calculated as the reference point from the 90-day study divided by the highest P95 exposure; for edible plant/animal sources a comparison with exposure to a similar fraction of the source material.
requirements.quote: The MoE is calculated as follows: MoE = Reference point/highest P95 value
